message.content:
**Analysis (based on the visible geometry):**

**1) Forward hilt stub visible? — PARTIALLY / WEAK.**
- The scabbard clearly angles down-back (line from hip ~(185,195) to ring end ~(105,218)) — that reads well.
- Forward of the hip there is only a very short stub: a small circle (likely the tsuba) at ~(185–190,193) with essentially no visible grip tube or pommel cap extending forward. The "tsuka" is barely 2–3 px long, so grip + kashira are **not clearly distinguishable**. Lengthen the forward stub (~10–15 px) with a distinct ring at the tsuba and a capped end.

**2) Fist welded on pommel end? — NO.**
- The hand/fist blob sits at ~(192,188), essentially at the hip/tsuba position, **not on the pommel end** of a forward stub. Since the stub itself is missing, the fist appears to float just forward of the hip ring — there's a visible small gap/overlap ambiguity at ~(187–191,190). The fist axis also reads nearly vertical/neutral rather than aligned with a hilt diagonal.

**3) Right elbow bends forward? — YES.**
- The right arm goes from shoulder ~(178,150) down to the hand at ~(192,188); the elbow at ~(185,168) bends forward (toward viewer/right), not backward. This is correct.

**4) Reads as "resting hand on sheathed katana"? — NOT YET.**
- Currently it reads as "figure with a back-dragging stick and hand near hip." To sell the pose:
  - Extend the forward tsuka ~12 px from the tsuba at ~(188,194) toward ~(200,188) (slightly up-forward diagonal, opposite/symmetrical to the scabbard angle).
  - Add bright steel-blue accent rings at tsuba (~(188,194)) and kashira (~(200,188)).
  - Move the fist to exactly cap the kashira at ~(200,188), with the forearm re-angled to match the hilt diagonal.

**Verdict:** Elbow ✅, scabbard ✅ — but the forward hilt is too short and the fist is not seated on the pommel, so the "hand resting on katana" read fails. Fix items 1–2 and it will land.
